answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 33145 Country: India Title: Is it sunnah to renew the wudhu before going to bed, even if we have the wudhu of Isha salah? Question: Is it sunnah to renew the wudhu before going to bed, even if we have the wudhu of Isha salah? Answer ID: 33145 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1437/873/H=1432) In the questioned mentioned above, wudhu is mustahab before going to bed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
